2607.11503.title: GEIS: A Generation-Evaluation-Improvement Loop of Agent Skills for Long-Form Article Generation
2607.11503.paper_summary: Long-form article generation remains difficult for large language models because it combines long context, long instructions, and long outputs. Existing multi-agent pipelines such as STORM improve information coverage by simulating role-specialized agents, but their capabilities are often entangled in prompts and fixed procedures, making them hard to inspect, reuse, or iteratively improve. This paper presents GEIS (Generation-Evaluation-Improvement loop of agent Skills), a loop of named and declarative skills for Wikipedia-style long-form article generation. Implemented and evaluated in Tasi Harness, GEIS composes skills for article writing, browser-based evidence and image collection, diagram rendering, PDF-aware pairwise evaluation, and rule-level skill improvement. Its core writing skill follows Request, Plan, Draft, Audit, Refine, and Deliver; the pairwise evaluation skill produces structured quality reports; and the improvement skill maps recurrent findings into permanent patches to the writing skill in our 20-topic experiment. We evaluate GEIS on 20 Wikipedia Featured Article topics. Under the same generation backend, GEIS improves over the Tasi Harness default writer by 8.0 points on a 100-point PDF quality rubric and outperforms STORM on the two comparable writing dimensions, structural quality and content quality. In the 20-topic improvement experiment, the patched writing skill raises the average score from 82.90 to 86.95, with 17 out of 20 topics improved and the gain mainly coming from content quality. These results show that long-form generation can be reframed from a fixed workflow into an inspectable, modular, and evaluation-guided improvement loop.
2607.11503.paper_summary_zh: 長篇文章生成對於大型語言模型來說仍然困難，因為它結合了長上下文、長指令和長輸出。現有的多代理管道如STORM通過模擬角色專門化的代理來改善信息覆蓋，但它們的能力往往被糾纏在提示和固定程序中，使得它們難以檢查、重用或迭代改進。本文提出了GEIS（生成-評估-改進代理技能循環），這是一個針對維基百科風格長篇文章生成的命名和聲明技能循環。在Tasi Harness中實施和評估的GEIS組合了文章寫作、基於瀏覽器的證據和圖像收集、圖表渲染、PDF感知的成對評估以及規則級別的技能改進。其核心寫作技能遵循請求、計劃、草擬、審核、精煉和交付；成對評估技能生成結構化的質量報告；而改進技能則將重複發現映射為我們20主題實驗中寫作技能的永久修補。 我們在20個維基百科特色文章主題上評估GEIS。在相同的生成後端下，GEIS在100分的PDF質量標準上比Tasi Harness的默認寫作工具提高了8.0分，並在結構質量和內容質量這兩個可比較的寫作維度上超越了STORM。在20主題的改進實驗中，修補過的寫作技能將平均分從82.90提高到86.95，其中20個主題中有17個得到了改善，增益主要來自內容質量。這些結果顯示長篇生成可以從固定工作流程重新框架為可檢查的、模塊化的和以評估為導向的改進循環。
